{{Conjecture|legends}}
During the early years of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], an '''Imperial scout base''' was established on the [[Gacerian]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Tempay]]. It was commanded by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Engar Ret]], and manned by over two hundred personnel support by twenty miscellaneous vehicles, a squadron of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] and a squadron of [[TIE/rc starfighter]]s.
